verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Zep ingests JSON, text, and messages (not just chat) into the Context Graph, and the homepage states Zep builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON, with custom entity/edge types for structuring business data. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent example of ingesting a real document or JSON payload beyond doc claims, and no detail on document parsing/chunking specifics.
